method.principle: COMMITTED_GOVERNANCE_ONLY. A slot is carried forward only if all ten requirements recompute true from committed bytes; the starting state is DERIVED from the per-slot outcomes by deriveGeneration2StartingState and is not written into any resolver

twoSources.A3_COMMITTED_GOVERNANCE_V4_AT_67AE047: the 69 slots whose Generation-1 terminal occupant was already decided at A2 checkpoint 67ae047. Resolved by running the UNCHANGED A3 R32 resolver resolveCommittedA2GovernanceV4 read-only in its own worktree at 747b64f (no A3 file, branch or registry modified). It parses every A2 window family from commit-addressed bytes, bridges the 13 prefix-only run references through the provenance closure and the 5 mixed-convention slots through the SD9 reconciliation, and reproduces its public census exactly (69 READY / 3 unsuccessful / 38 no terminal evidence)
twoSources.A2_WINDOW_ADJUDICATION_AFTER_67AE047: the 6 slots decided after 67ae047 by Windows 08..11, whose adjudications publish drawEntrySha256, a full runRefSha256, everyObservationV7 and the repaired SD7->SD9 bridge uniformly; parsed directly

method.whyV4IsNotCopiedAsAConclusion: every per-slot fact taken from V4 (disposition path + sha256, live result, run reference, policy version, transition ledger) is re-verified by the committed A2 test against the A2 bytes at this HEAD: the file SHA-256 must match, the bound records must name the occupant, the run reference must appear verbatim in its bound holder, the policy version must appear in the adjudication or live result
method.publicationDiscipline: A3 treats its per-slot authority object as internal. This A2 record republishes only fields A2 already publishes in its own public adjudications - selection index, split, draw-entry digest, run-reference digest, record paths - and no eche row key, organisation id, hostname, URL or page content. Draw-entry digests are sha256(canonicalStringify(draw entry)) of the public frozen draw
method.occupantDerivation: landed Generation-1 currentOccupantForSelectionIndex over the frozen draw plus the committed 39-entry ledger, every index 0..109

requirements.R1: the occupant is the Generation-1 terminal CURRENT occupant of its slot (kind, reserve position, ledger sequence and drawEntrySha256 all recompute)
requirements.R2: the Generation-1 terminal record classifies the slot successful (not a failure, not pending, not never-started)
requirements.R3: the disposition authority is committed (file present, SHA-256 matches, live result and transition ledger SHA-256 match) and the bound records name THIS occupant by draw-entry digest or full run reference
requirements.R4: a full 64-hex run reference appears verbatim in its bound holder (adjudication, live result, policy-transition ledger, provenance closure or SD9 reconciliation)
requirements.R5: the acquisition policy version is well-formed and committed in the adjudication or live result
requirements.R6: no later Generation-1 ledger entry supersedes the occupant
requirements.R7: successful under the repaired SD9 interpretation: via the SD9 reconciliation (recomputed all 110 slots over the 30-entry ledger; slot neither failed nor pending after it; no later ledger entry for the slot), or via a post-reconciliation adjudication whose orderOfRules names the repaired bridge and whose item for this draw-entry digest is ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL with the same run reference
requirements.R8: no capability review is pending (terminal PENDING_CAPABILITY_REVIEW is empty)
requirements.R9: the split equals the unchanged draw split of the selection index
requirements.R10: the carry-forward record holds exactly the structural field set, so no semantic reinspection is needed or possible

mixedAcquisitionPolicyVersions.finding: 66 of the 75 carried successes were acquired under orgunit-fetch-policy-v1..v6, 9 under v7
mixedAcquisitionPolicyVersions.whyThisIsNotAnInvalidation: the repository already settled that fetchPolicyVersion is historical RUN PROVENANCE, not an algorithm version a later build must match (owner decision PIN_HISTORICAL_FETCH_POLICY_VERSION, 471bcd9 / 01658bf), and every Generation-1 policy transition was adjudicated through the committed acquisition-policy transition ledgers. Each later policy only repaired a way of FAILING (robots redirect continuation, bounded transport retry, document base, RCDATA, trailing-slash robots); none redefined success. A success therefore keeps its own recorded policy version
mixedAcquisitionPolicyVersions.noReacquisitionProposed: generation naming alone invalidates no authority; a specific invalidated authority would be required, and none was found

a3Reuse.conclusion: an unchanged Generation-2 occupant carries an unchanged acquisition authority (same draw-entry digest, run reference, disposition record and policy version), so existing A3 durable evidence, document and SD7-graph work bound to those authorities stays valid. A future Generation-2 A3 governance version would pin a new A2 checkpoint and compare old vs new authorities mechanically (R26-style comparator); the one DEV_TRAIN success decided after 67ae047 (slot 66, Window 08) is the only DEV_TRAIN authority not yet covered and would enter as an incremental delta
